name: @nyllsom/soda
description: 用 Markdown 与声明式动画制作可分享的 HTML 演示

scripts.examples:build: node bin/soda.js examples/quickstart/deck.md -o examples/preview/quickstart-nju.html && node bin/soda.js examples/quickstart/deck.md --theme ipads -o examples/preview/quickstart-ipads.html && node bin/soda.js examples/showcase/deck.md -o examples/preview/showcase-nju.html && node bin/soda.js examples/showcase/deck.md --theme ipads -o examples/preview/showcase-ipads.html
